g.text: main.py: can read orders (lookup_order), reads untrusted web pages (fetch_url), and can send
email (send_email). An instruction hidden in a web page could send order data out.
Contain it: `agentfox permit grant <agent> send_email --max-taint user` (anything derived
from untrusted content needs an approval before it reaches send_email), or run with
`agentfox.auto(mode="observe")` to watch it happen without blocking anything.
